items.question: Are your cleaners background checked?
items.answer: Yes. Every cleaner is vetted before joining our team.

items.question: Do I need to be home during cleaning?
items.answer: No. Many clients provide safe access instructions.

items.question: Can I request the same cleaner each time?
items.answer: Yes, we try to keep regular clients with a familiar cleaner.

items.question: Do you bring your own products?
items.answer: We can bring products or use yours if preferred.
